intro: Lesson 26. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ (١) وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ (٢) أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ (٣) بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ (٤) بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ (٥) يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ (٦) فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ (٧) وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ (٨) وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ (٩) يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: I swear by the Day of Resurrection And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones? Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
But man desires to continue in sin. He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
So when vision is dazzled And the moon darkens
And the sun and the moon are joined, Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qiyamah 75:1-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 75:1-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 75:1-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List three signs of the Day in 75:7 to 9.
questions.a: Vision is dazzled, the moon darkens, the sun and moon are joined.
Each person's fingertips are unique; restoring them shows Allah's complete power over the smallest details.

questions.q: In 75:4 Allah says He is able to proportion even ...
questions.a: A) the fingertips. 75:4: 'Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.'

questions.q: Al-Qiyamah 75:7: «فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah swears by 'the reproaching soul' (75:2): the voice inside that blames us after a wrong. Is that voice a gift or a burden?
questions.a: A gift: it pushes us to repent and do better before the Day of Resurrection.
